video_title: Kevin Love joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: Kevin Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love on the difficulty of sacrificing his role in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to make it seem like I was this great guy that came in and sacrificed
quotes.quote: I don't want to make it seem like I was this great guy that came in and sacrificed right away. It was tough for me initially to do that because I didn't have a great veteran until the triangle came along, which was you and Channing, that helped change my life in that way.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love on his role alongside LeBron James and Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I came in and thought I'll probably be the third guy, but I'm still going to be able
quotes.quote: I came in and thought I'll probably be the third guy, but I'm still going to be able to put up my fair share of numbers and play my game. With those two, one guy who's a freight train in LeBron James, another who is a magician with the basketball, the thing that I had to do in order for that team to thrive was space the floor.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love on the atmosphere during the 2016 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: It just felt like there was literally the air was different. It changed in that moment.
quotes.quote: It just felt like there was literally the air was different. It changed in that moment.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love on the influence of Dirk Nowitzki on his game
quotes.excerpt: Dirk had one of the biggest influences if not the biggest influence on my career.
quotes.quote: Dirk Nowitzki had one of the biggest influences if not the biggest influence on my career. My dad had told me early on in my career, you need to watch this guy bring the ball up the floor, watch him rebound, watch him shoot from deep, he plays inside out. This is where the game is going. Guys are going to be taller, guys are going to be up to seven feet shooting the ball.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love on his defensive stop against Stephen Curry in Game 7
quotes.excerpt: I just forced him into a tough shot. People want to say it was this great stop.
quotes.quote: I just forced him into a tough shot. People want to say it was this great stop, but actually, I just forced him into a tough shot. At the very least, I have to allow him to maybe break the paint, somebody can go on there and make a play and we're just going to scramble.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love on the importance of celebrating teammates
quotes.excerpt: You don't have to necessarily be the guy at the top or the guy in charge
quotes.quote: You don't have to necessarily be the guy at the top or the guy in charge necessarily to be the leader, but such a big part of that is also celebrating others. I've learned that as a veteran as well and you get what you give.
